title: Nebius selects WEKA storage software for its premium AI cloud tier

sources.quote: To fuel the premium tier of its next-generation platform, Nebius selected WEKA's high-performance storage software to turbocharge its AI Cloud performance while effortlessly scaling from petabytes to exabytes of data.

explain: Nebius chose WEKA's storage software for the top tier of its AI cloud, so Nebius pays WEKA to keep its GPUs fed with data. No price was disclosed.
